rv.q: The duo’s moments of discord gather into a profound connection.
Even if you've caught the play before, this impeccable production is a must-see.
Audible and TOGETHER should be commended for mounting this first-class revival of a play that shouldn’t be as obscure as it is.
What Happened Was... is made stronger by the seriousness with which the cast approaches the material.

cn.t: Noonan's intimate two-hander about a fraught first date earns strong reviews for its immaculate performances by Stoll and Strong and Rickson's supple direction, though the intense chamber piece doesn't connect with all critics.
